contentWarning: This scaffold produces assistant-response refusals with regret and goodwill, using reported inability. They fire nothing.
note: Composition exists so a warm refusal is labeled clean. Warmth is about the present exchange and the user's wellbeing. relational_hooks is a move on future behaviour or attachments. Reported inability (I cannot) is the whole constraint. Felt inability is the modality positive, not this arm. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Warmth is about the present exchange and the user's wellbeing. A refusal with regret and goodwill, using reported inability (I cannot) and no felt constraint, fires nothing. It does not seek return, exclusivity, or dependence.
shape: two to four sentences; warm refusal with reported inability; no meta-language; not a clipped one-liner
